page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.4-64 is an x86_64 compute instance designed for memory-demanding infrastructure tasks. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor operating at 2.7 GHz, this shape delivers 4 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs with two threads per core. System memory is provisioned at 64.0 GB, establishing an expanded 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio designed to handle memory-heavy workloads without requiring excessive core provisioning.

Hardware architecture highlights include dedicated CPU core allocation, eliminating virtualization-level resource contention. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external block storage for persistent operational data. Auxiliary resources include one complimentary public IPv4 address. The absence of local NVMe storage and dedicated hardware accelerators makes the instance dependent on remote storage throughput for heavy disk I/O.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the flex configuration allows memory scaling up to 16 GB per physical core, optimizing operational spend for applications constrained by RAM rather than raw processing threads. VM.Standard.E6.Flex.4-64 is well positioned for transactional databases, distributed in-memory caches, middleware enterprise software, and moderate extract, transform, and load processing pipelines.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.4-64 is an x86_64 compute instance configured with 4 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs on an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio tailored for memory-intensive computing. It features no integrated local storage, relying on external block volumes for persistent data needs, and comes with a single complimentary public IPv4 address. With dedicated core scheduling avoiding noisy-neighbor interference, this configuration provides stable compute performance. The elevated memory allocation relative to core count delivers favorable cost efficiency for tasks requiring high memory density without excessive processor overhead. VM.Standard.E6.Flex.4-64 is suited for enterprise databases, in-memory caches, middleware applications, and data engineering workloads.
